capabilities: Records system audio and microphone on macOS
Generates a live Mandarin Chinese transcript
Refines transcripts with a local Whisper model
Places slides on the transcript timeline
extras: One-time Terminal setup required (zsh install.sh) and must be re-run after each plugin update; install.sh downloads Homebrew packages and a 1.6 GB Whisper model from Hugging Face. Plugin and recorder make no network requests; recognition uses macOS built-in recognizers and a local model. Free, no account, payment, ads or telemetry; optional Ko-fi support. Interface language forced via "lang" in data.json (default auto).
problem: Obsidian has no way to capture meeting audio from the Mac, transcribe it live, or align presentation slides with the transcript.

relations.evidence: watches ~/Downloads for AnnotateScreen screenshots to import

requires.name: macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon, desktop only
Swift recorder installed by running zsh install.sh into ~/.config/meeting-recorder/

summary: macOS plugin that records system audio and microphone, with live Mandarin transcript, local Whisper refinement, and slides on the transcript timeline.
